verdict.rationale: Rippling's own Time & Attendance feature applies location-based labor policies and flags potential risks by each employee's work location before payroll runs. That covers the location slice of proactive compliance alerting. Its custom notification workflows are only a building block the user must configure, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: proactive alerts triggered by a new hire creating an obligation (e.g., state registration), alerts for law or regulatory changes, founder-directed notification delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation

citations.quote: flags potential risks based on each employee's work location so managers can act before issues reach payroll
Rippling automatically applies the correct labor policies—from overtime to breaks—based on location, and flags potential risks based on each employee's work location
